newsitem.title: FRANCE: French dealers see further share rises - paper.
newsitem.headline: French dealers see further share rises - paper.

text.p: French financial professionals see further rises in share prices and on average advise their clients to hold on their shares, according to a poll conducted by the Sofres institute for the La Tribune newspaper.
Of 140 professionals polled on February 13 and 14, 55 percent expect a futher rise in French shares, 12 percent see a decline and 32 percent see stability.
The number of "sellers" is slightly increasing.
